Claim: session `session_01YBWFb5YgMU5dw8p2VKj16S` · branch `claude/issue-8450-inspector-select-placeholder`

PM dispatch (`domain:ui` seat). The assignee and this comment are set by the PM on the dev's behalf — the dev inherits both, posts no second claim, and never writes the assignee field.

**Decision frame.** The **mechanism** is measured and not in doubt: the field bridges the caller's value through `toInner(value ?? '')`, so empty/undefined becomes a sentinel matching no `SelectItem`, and Radix shows a placeholder only for an *undefined* value. What is **not** settled, and is yours to measure and propose: which repair — pass `undefined` to Radix and handle "no selection" another way, or keep the sentinel and render the placeholder outside `SelectValue`. **Measured cost is the whole basis**; no axis analysis expected. If the two are equivalent on cost, say so and pick, with the reason.

⚠️ **61 call sites.** Whichever repair you choose changes **what an empty select looks like across the whole designer**. The PR needs a before/after of a **representative sample** — not just the primitive's own test — and the sample has to be chosen by measurement (which call sites pass an explicit placeholder, which rely on the `'—'` default, which are never empty in practice), not by convenience.

⚠️ **The existing test is a trap and a gift.** `_shared.select.test.tsx` case 3 asserts an explicit placeholder is absent and attributes it to the `''` option matching. **The assertion is correct; its stated reason is not the operative one.** Correct the reason rather than delete the case — that case becomes your ablation.

⚠️ Ask whether an implementation strictly worse than the bug would pass: a field that renders the placeholder **always**, including when a value is selected, satisfies "the placeholder appears when empty". Pin the selected-value case as the non-regression half.

Context: this **unblocks the select half of objectui#6830's ruled direction A** (its boolean half landed as PR #8473). ⛔ Do not implement that half here — this card is the primitive only.

## Correction to this card's own count — "61 call sites" was mine, and it is worse than a stale number

The title said **61**. The real figure is **45**. I have corrected the title; this comment records *why the wrong number needed more than a silent edit*.

Measured on `origin/main` (`git grep -o '<InspectorSelectField' -- 'packages/*/src/*'`):

| tree | `<InspectorSelectField` elements | production call sites |
|---|---|---|
| `origin/main` | 51 | **45** (6 of the 51 are in `_shared.labels.test.tsx` / `_shared.select.test.tsx`) |
| `claude/issue-8450-inspector-select-placeholder` (PR #8494) | **61** | 45 |

61 is not a number from nowhere, and it is not merely stale. **It is exactly what the merged tree will read once PR #8494's pins land.** The fix PR adds ten more elements — all of them test fixtures — and the repo-wide element count lands on the precise figure this card asserted before any of them existed.

So a future reader who greps the merged tree, gets 61, and concludes the card was right will be counting the fix's own test file as evidence for the claim. A wrong number that becomes self-confirming is worth more than a footnote in a review thread, which is why it goes on the card itself.

The number that matters for the defect is **45**: the production call sites at which the `placeholder` prop was accepted and never reachable.

Credit where it is due — the dev corrected this in the commit title (`…unreachable at all 45 call sites`) rather than carrying my figure forward.
